newsitem.title: CHINA: Sino-Dutch joint venture to develop bauxite.
newsitem.headline: Sino-Dutch joint venture to develop bauxite.

text.p: A Sino-Dutch joint venture has started operations in China's southwestern Guizhou province to develop bauxite resources in the province, Xinhua news agency said.

The Guizhou BDDA Mineral Co is jointly funded by Guizhou Xianghai Industry Trading Co and the Prejon International B.Y. of the Netherlands. Total investment in the venture is 10 million yuan, with each side providing 50 percent.
The joint venture will be mainly engaged in developing bauxite resources in Guizhou, which has reserves of more than 200 million tonnes, Xinhua said.
It will operate a mine with an annual output of 100,000 tonnes of bauxite ore, 90 percent of which will be exported to Europe, Xinhua added.
